# creative-director

> Cited, checkable design rules and a light-touch critique loop that AI agents use to judge and improve visual work.

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): start here; says what to load
- [Core principles](core/principles.md): always loaded
- [Critique loop](core/critique-loop.md): always loaded; read the ask, brief, render, look, critique, fix, take over, deliver; the blocker list
- [Critique template](core/critique-template.md): when writing a critique
- [Creative direction](core/creative-direction.md): intent, mood and judging between versions
- [First-principles remake](core/first-principles.md): when asked to redo or reimagine from scratch
- [Which modules to load](core/which-modules.md): task-to-module table and token costs
- [Evidence](core/evidence.md): grades and myths, before claiming people prefer something
- [Modules](modules/): technical-drawing, illustration, character, web-ui, ux, 3d, typography, layout, brand, aesthetic-critique, composition, colour-value
- [Lite version](lite/CREATIVE-DIRECTOR-LITE.md): loop, core rules and blockers in one short file
- [Font library](fonts/README.md): theme-grouped free fonts (OFL / Apache) with a catalogue and specimens
- [Tools](tools/README.md): measuring scripts (contrast, grids, perspective, ellipses, intersections, whitespace, balance)
- [Case study](examples/case-study-may-specials/README.md): one sign remade from first principles, with every check shown
- [Sources](SOURCES.md)
- [Bibliography](BIBLIOGRAPHY.md): annotated reading list on composition, colour and beauty, with links to public-domain full texts
